required.reason: One coordinator must retain synthesis, integration, validation, and both user gates.
Each findings role must have one unique writable output while all other run artifacts remain read-only.
The installed plugin validators must execute locally and return a reliable exit status.
RequestPacket, context, findings, requirement, bundle, readback, and acceptance identities depend on SHA-256.
The configured run root must persist exact JSON bytes across all barriers.
The runtime must end at requirement review and again after presenting a verified build.
Every delegated role must receive only its validated packet path, without inherited conversation, raw request, full context, immutable Draft, or model/reasoning overrides.

multi-agent.failurePolicy: do not claim or enter multi-agent mode

sequential-compatibility.disclosure: Report that role isolation was preserved but parallel multi-agent execution was unavailable.

configuration.runRoot: required runtime input; no machine-specific default in the adapter
configuration.pluginRoot: required runtime input or installed-plugin discovery result
configuration.mcpEndpoint: optional runtime configuration; never embedded in artifacts
